categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and completely redesigns transaction relay for private broadcast, removing legacy broadcast logic from CConnman and PeerManager.
categories.rationale: Replaces the coupled private broadcast mechanism with isolated, Tor-only job-based broadcast tasks that substantially improve transaction origin privacy. Decoupling private broadcast threads and SOCKS5/BIP324 connections entirely from CConnman and PeerManager eliminates timing and connection-state leak vectors while retiring complex special-casing in core networking components.
